fields.max_bid_ceiling: Hard safety guardrail ceiling in USD CPM (e.g. $10.00).
fields.budget_remaining: Unspent campaign budget remaining in USD (e.g. $2500.00).
fields.hours_remaining: Flight time remaining in hours (24.0h down to 0.0h).
fields.win_rate: Trailing win rate ratio (0.0 to 1.0) from recent auction ticks.
fields.market_price: Competitor market price benchmark to beat in USD CPM.
fields.market_price_history: Trailing sequence of recent market prices for momentum velocity.
fields.win_rate_history: Trailing sequence of recent win rates over recent ticks.
fields.active_bid_cpm: The CPM bid price submitted from the preceding tick.
